Owner click is the only send

sendMessage in lib/engine.ts is the only path that
contacts a prospect; crons draft, detect replies
and confirm queued LinkedIn actions but never
send.
Source: AGENTS.md
Fail-closed pre-send checks

Send claims the row (draft|failed→sending), checks
24h limits, re-checks Gmail replies and in-touch
status; a failed check sends nothing.
Source: lib/engine.ts
Worker exits only via home node

Runs stay queued unless Tailscale exit node is
online and proxied IP differs from Fly's; a
restart mid-run fails it instead of replaying.
Source: browser/worker.py
